summary: A better Blitz than a classic daily. Casual players know Gretzky, Ovechkin and Howe, then lose lives on Crosby, Lemieux and McDavid; in Blitz those names score.
reasons: Casual classic: Gretzky, Ovechkin, Howe, Jagr and Messier, but Crosby (#15), Lemieux (#11), McDavid, Orr and Kane each cost a life. Out of lives at 5/10 after 10 guesses.
Dionne, Gartner and Esposito are names most non-fans have never heard; fans get 10/10 easily, with Lemieux and Selanne as good near misses.
Blitz works: Crosby, Lemieux, Malkin, Stamkos and Kane all carry a stat, so a casual run scores 12 of 16.
fixes: Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries: Gretzky 'Trevor Gretzky', "Gretzky's Office", 'The Trade'; Howe 'Missus Hockey', 'The Howe Family'. On #15 Crosby: 'Troy Crosby', 'Cindy Crosby'. Drop redirects that name relatives, events or insults.
Source line says 'data as of 2025' but the totals (Ovechkin 929, Crosby 654) look like they include 2025-26; check and update the date label.
